apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64.AppImage, for 4K, 16K and 64K page kernels alike
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- iOS: skip the indentation commit in git blame
- Translations: the MaliSX2 driver notice in all 19 languages
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile on the source with the VU1 chunk store and the EE two-issue timing model
- microVU: the program memory bound is 192 MiB
- VU1 chunk store: a lookup that installs a body writes no log line
- VU AOT: a routine keeps up to 32 tiered bodies
- VU AOT: a routine's finished jobs wait for their own copies
- VU AOT: a tiered body taken in at a copy leaves its root's job for a copy outside it
- VU1 chunk store: a routine brings back as many of the tier's bodies as a head keeps
- VU1 chunk store: only a copy whose tiered body cannot be placed asks at its first run
- VU1 chunk store: a routine brings back the 16 plain bodies used last
- VU1 chunk store: print its counters at each reset, and count the first tiered placement since the reset
- VU AOT: the tier's state goes in the chunk store's pack, and sidecar records go
- VU1: the chunk store's pack replaces program images
- VU1 chunk store: keep its bodies in the program cache's pack
- VU1 chunk store: the skipped count includes the compiles of bail targets
- VU AOT: a job always takes the port's first pass of its root
- VU1 chunk store: delete the retire path for a change of options
- microVU: delete the VU1 lookup shift test hook
- VU AOT: delete the live tier's body hook
- Tests: the VU AOT tier's job and tripwire bookkeeping of a routine's copies
- VU1 chunk store: keep the 16 plain bodies of a root used last
- microVU: reset when the programs and their blocks hold 96 MiB
- VU AOT: a tier-up job scans its micro image for sticky readers
- VU AOT: count a compiling dispatch with the state it searched with
- microVU: IbitHack Imm11 of LQ, SQ, ILW and ISW in one sbfx
- microVU: VU1 IbitHack immediates load from the placement's micro memory
- VU1 chunk store: tests for IbitHack reads across the top and below the root
- Tests: run the T-bit end tests on VU1 as well as VU0
- microVU: placed copies of a VU1 chunk share the jump tables of its code
- VU AOT: a finished job waits for a copy that needs it, and the jump path does not ask again at once
- VU AOT: close four holes in the tier's bookkeeping of a routine's copies
- VU AOT: delete the sidecar format
- VU AOT: the tier-up log line gives the routine's jump entries too
- VU AOT: a routine's regions are built once and shared by every copy
- microVU: a VU1 JR or JALR takes its block from the placement's slot
- Tests: compare BAL and JALR link values and TPC whole in the chunk store and reload tests
- microVU: keep compiled VU1 chunks by what the compiler read, and install them instead of compiling again
- microVU: VU1 code reaches its blocks and its links out of a chunk through placement slots
- microVU: VU1 code takes its micro-memory addresses from a root
- Tests: VU1 micro-memory addresses at the wrap
- iOS: normalize Swift indentation to four spaces
- iOS: press the ringed alert button with Return or space
- iOS: register the VM observers once, not on every scene connect
- iOS: keep the game view when the scene reconnects
- iOS: load the startup settings once, not on every scene connect
- iOS: cut SavedPaletteColor comments to the style limits
- iOS: cut DynamicParticleOverlay comments to the style limits
- iOS: cut ControllerGameContextMenu comments to the style limits
- iOS: cut ControllerAccessibilityNavigation comments to the style limits
- iOS: cut QuickMenuView comments to the style limits
- iOS: cut DynamicBackgroundPresentation comments to the style limits

- iOS: make the OrbitKeys binding setter main-actor
- iOS: discard the Set results inside the shader row transactions
